title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Organisation Name:**
Sri Madhusudan Sai Global Humanitarian Mission

**Job Title:**
Marketing Manager

**Location:**
Muddenahalli, Karnataka

**About Us:**

Sri Madhusudan Sai Global Humanitarian Mission passionately provides free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare to those in need across 100 countries. Under the visionary leadership of the globally acclaimed humanitarian, Sadguru Sri Madhusudan Sai, the Organisation is dedicated to uplifting the most marginalised communities. The mission is grounded in the ethos of selfless service, guided by the belief that all are a part of ‘One World, One Family’.

**Job Overview:**

As the Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for developing and executing strategic marketing initiatives to promote the organisation's mission, programs, and fundraising efforts. Your role will involve leading marketing campaigns, engaging with diverse stakeholders, and leveraging various channels to increase brand awareness, attract supporters, and drive engagement. By aligning marketing strategies with our organisational objectives, you will play a vital role in advancing our impact and outreach within the community.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement comprehensive marketing plans and strategies to support the organisation's mission, goals, and initiatives.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify target audiences, key messages, and value propositions for marketing campaigns and initiatives.
* Oversee the creation of marketing materials, including print collateral, digital content, social media assets, and promotional merchandise, ensuring consistency and adherence to brand guidelines.
* **Create and Implement strategies acros**
  s digital marketing channels, including website, social media platforms, email campaigns, and online advertising, to increase visibility and engagement.
* Conduct market research, audience analysis, and competitor benchmarking to identify trends, opportunities, and best practices for marketing outreach.
* Plan and execute marketing events, workshops, webinars, and community outreach activities to raise awareness and promote participation in our programs and events.
* Collaborate with fundraising team to develop and implement donor acquisition and retention strategies, leveraging marketing tactics to engage donors and supporters.
* Track and analyse marketing metrics, such as website traffic, social media engagement, email open rates, and campaign performance, to evaluate effectiveness and optimize strategies.
* Cultivate relationships with media partners, influencers, and external stakeholders to enhance visibility and amplify messaging through earned media opportunities.
* Stay informed about emerging trends, technologies, and innovations in marketing, sharing insights and recommendations with the team to enhance marketing efforts.

**Requirements:**

* Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate organisational goals into actionable marketing strategies and tactics.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, including internal teams, donors, volunteers, and community partners.
* Proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms, including content management systems (CMS), email marketing software, social media management tools, and analytics platforms.
* Creative mindset and ability to think outside the box to develop innovative marketing ideas and campaigns that resonate with target audiences.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Knowledge of ethical standards and best practices in marketing, including data privacy regulations, content copyright, and transparency guidelines.
* A passion for social causes and a commitment to the mission and values of the organisation.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business administration, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Proven experience of 5+ years in marketing roles, with a track record of developing and executing successful marketing campaigns and initiatives.

**Location/Work Environment:**
This is a full-time, work from office role.

**Why Join Us?**

Joining SMSGHM offers a chance to impact marginalised communities globally. With a focus on free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare across 100 countries, your efforts directly contribute to positive change. Being part of our mission means experiencing the joy of helping others and knowing your contributions bring happiness to those in need.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vijesha IT Services LLP is a technology and education company delivering custom software, web and mobile applications, and scalable digital solutions for diverse clients. The organization designs impactful digital marketing strategies, intuitive UI/UX experiences, and robust e\-commerce platforms to help brands grow and operate efficiently. It supports businesses through cloud\-smart solutions and corporate training programs, while its EdTech platform offers IT and non\-IT courses, live expert sessions, and real\-world internships. With operations in India and the UK, Vijesha IT Services LLP combines global best practices with local market insights. The company fosters a collaborative, inclusive culture and is driven by a mission to make technology and education accessible and engaging.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Digital Marketing Executive role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Koramangala. This role involves planning and executing digital marketing campaigns across channels such as social media, search, and email to increase brand visibility and lead generation. The Digital Marketing Executive will create and optimize web and social media content, monitor campaign performance using web analytics tools, and prepare reports with insights and recommendations. Daily responsibilities include managing social media calendars, coordinating with design and content teams, and ensuring consistent brand messaging. The role also includes staying updated on digital marketing trends, competitor activities, and best practices to support continuous improvement of marketing strategies.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Marketing skills with experience in planning and executing digital campaigns.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication and collaboration with cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess Social Media Marketing skills with hands\-on experience managing platforms such as Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and YouTube.
* Candidates should possess Web Content Writing skills, including the ability to create engaging, brand\-aligned content for websites, blogs, and landing pages.
* Candidates should possess Web Analytics skills, including the ability to use tools like Google Analytics or similar platforms to track and optimize campaign performance.
* Relevant skills such as basic SEO/SEM knowledge, familiarity with marketing automation or CRM tools, and an understanding of PPC advertising are beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is preferred.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, on\-site team environment are advantageous.

title: Sales & Marketing Manager
description:
This job is provided by apna.co Job Responsibilities:Plan and execute daily live bird sales according to company production schedules Develop and maintain strong relationships with wholesalers, retailers, and institutional customers.
   

  

 Monitor daily market prices and recommend competitive pricing strategies.
   

  

 Coordinate with production and farm teams to ensure timely bird availability.
   

  

 Achieve monthly and annual sales volume and revenue targets.
   

  

 Ensure birds are marketed at the optimum body weight and age for maximum profitability.
   

  

 Coordinate transportation and logistics for timely delivery of live birds.
   

  

 Resolve customer complaints regarding bird quality, weight, or delivery.
   

  

 Monitor competitor activities, pricing, and market trends.
   

  

 Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports for management review.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with company SOPs, biosecurity protocols, and quality standards during marketing operations.
   

  

 Minimize mortality and weight loss during loading, transportation, and delivery.
   

  

 Coordinate with finance teams for customer payments, collections, and credit management.
   

  

 Identify new markets and expand the customer base in assigned territories.
   

  

 Forecast customer demand and communicate requirements to production planning teams.
   

  

 Conduct regular customer visits to strengthen business relationships and improve customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Support promotional campaigns and marketing initiatives to increase market share.
   

  

 Ensure accurate documentation of sales transactions, dispatch records, invoices, and customer data.
   

  

 Continuously improve sales performance through market analysis, operational efficiency, and adherence to integrated poultry management practices.Ensure payment collection within given timeline
